trigger_scope: AI systems within Article 4 actor/scope conditions
requirement_candidate: Maintain context-sensitive AI-literacy measures for staff and other persons operating or using AI systems on the actor's behalf
evidence_required: Role-based training records; competence content; attendance/completion evidence; periodic review record
technical_control_candidate: Role-based AI literacy program with training assignment and evidence capture
limitations: No guaranteed individual literacy level inferred; context and technical knowledge/experience/use context matter

trigger_scope: AI system intended to interact directly with natural persons where Article 50(1) applies
requirement_candidate: Provide the legally required disclosure that the person is interacting with an AI system at the required time and in the required manner
evidence_required: User-interface disclosure specification; screenshots/test evidence; accessibility review; release trace
technical_control_candidate: Human-facing AI-interaction disclosure control with testable UX acceptance criteria
limitations: Article 50 exceptions and exact subparagraph scope remain controlling; no disclosure beyond source scope inferred

trigger_scope: AI systems generating synthetic audio/image/video/text within Article 50(2)
requirement_candidate: Implement the Article 50(2) machine-readable marking/detectability requirement for in-scope synthetic outputs
evidence_required: Output samples; marking/detectability test results; model/system version linkage; exception analysis
technical_control_candidate: Synthetic-output provenance/marking and detectability verification control
limitations: Legacy systems described by Article 111(4) have transition until 2026-12-02; exact exceptions and technical feasibility wording control

duty_bearer: Systemic or non-systemic GPAI provider as applicable
trigger_scope: GPAI model provider within Article 53 documentation/downstream-information scope
requirement_candidate: Maintain required model technical documentation and provide required information/documentation to downstream AI-system providers
evidence_required: Versioned technical documentation; distribution record; change history; downstream handoff evidence
technical_control_candidate: Version-controlled model documentation and downstream information handoff workflow
limitations: Article 111(3) legacy-model transition applies; exact Article 53 scope and free/open-source qualification preserved

trigger_scope: GPAI model provider within Article 53 copyright-policy scope
requirement_candidate: Maintain a policy to comply with Union copyright law as required by Article 53
evidence_required: Approved copyright-compliance policy; ownership/review record; operational procedures; update history
technical_control_candidate: Governed copyright-compliance policy lifecycle with review and traceability
limitations: Candidate does not define what Union copyright law requires in a concrete training/data scenario; Article 53 qualifications preserved

trigger_scope: GPAI model provider within Article 53 public-summary scope
requirement_candidate: Prepare and make publicly available the required sufficiently detailed summary about content used for training according to the applicable template/rule
evidence_required: Published summary; publication timestamp; source/version trace; approval record
technical_control_candidate: Controlled training-content-summary publication workflow with version history
limitations: Candidate does not infer disclosure of protected/confidential material beyond the legal rule; Commission template/implementation details control

trigger_scope: GPAI model classified as having systemic risk and within Article 55
requirement_candidate: Perform required model evaluation including adversarial testing under Article 55
evidence_required: Evaluation plan; adversarial-test cases/results; evaluator identity; remediation records; version linkage
technical_control_candidate: Repeatable adversarial-evaluation pipeline with release gating and evidence retention
limitations: Systemic-risk classification and exact Article 55 testing standard must be established separately; no universal test suite inferred

trigger_scope: GPAI model classified as having systemic risk and within Article 55
requirement_candidate: Assess and mitigate systemic risks as required by Article 55
evidence_required: Systemic-risk register; assessment evidence; mitigation decisions; residual-risk review; change history
technical_control_candidate: Systemic-risk assessment and mitigation workflow linked to model versions and release decisions
limitations: No universal risk taxonomy or zero-risk requirement inferred; exact Article 55 standard and classification control

trigger_scope: Serious incident within Article 55 reporting/tracking scope
requirement_candidate: Maintain serious-incident tracking and reporting capability sufficient to perform Article 55 duties
evidence_required: Incident record; classification rationale; notification/report receipt; timeline; corrective-action evidence
technical_control_candidate: Serious-incident intake/classification/reporting workflow with immutable event chronology
limitations: Serious-incident definition and reporting destination/timing are source-controlled; incident does not prove causation or liability

trigger_scope: GPAI model classified as having systemic risk and within Article 55 cybersecurity scope
requirement_candidate: Implement cybersecurity protection measures required by Article 55 for the model and relevant infrastructure
evidence_required: Threat model; access-control evidence; security test results; vulnerability/remediation records; monitoring evidence
technical_control_candidate: Model/infrastructure security control baseline with adversarial testing vulnerability handling and monitoring
limitations: Article 55 does not by itself prescribe one OWASP control set; candidate control vocabulary remains destination-review material

trigger_scope: Personal-data processing within GDPR and controller accountability scope
requirement_candidate: Maintain evidence sufficient to demonstrate compliance with applicable GDPR principles under Article 5(2)
evidence_required: Accountability records; approvals; processing decisions; control evidence; review history
technical_control_candidate: Compliance-evidence register linking processing purpose data flows controls and accountable owners
limitations: Article 5(2) is accountability; it is not general civil discovery and does not prescribe a specific engineering architecture

requirement_candidate: Make available information needed to demonstrate Article 28 compliance and contribute to audits/inspections as legally required
evidence_required: Processor compliance package; audit evidence; request/response log; control attestations
technical_control_candidate: Processor audit-evidence interface with controlled evidence export and request logging
limitations: Not general litigation disclosure; contractual and GDPR scope conditions remain controlling

trigger_scope: Actor and processing fall within Article 30 scope and no applicable exception removes the duty
requirement_candidate: Maintain the required records of processing activities and make them available to the supervisory authority on request
evidence_required: Current ROPA; owner/version history; data-category/purpose/recipient/retention/security fields as applicable
technical_control_candidate: Structured processing-record registry with ownership versioning and supervisory-export capability
limitations: ROPA is not automatically an AI operational log; Article 30 conditions/exemptions remain controlling

trigger_scope: High-risk AI system after the applicable Article 6 pathway date and within Article 12 scope
requirement_candidate: Design in-scope high-risk AI systems with automatic event-logging capability sufficient for legally required traceability
evidence_required: Log schema; event coverage tests; time/version integrity evidence; traceability demonstrations
technical_control_candidate: Tamper-evident event logging and traceability subsystem linked to system/model/version identifiers
limitations: Phased applicability preserved; Article 12 is not civil discovery; exact logging content depends on legal/technical context

trigger_scope: Automatically generated Article 12 logs under provider control after applicable high-risk date
requirement_candidate: Retain provider-controlled logs for a period appropriate to intended purpose and at least six months unless other applicable law provides otherwise
evidence_required: Retention-policy configuration; deletion/hold history; integrity checks; legal-basis/exception record
technical_control_candidate: Policy-driven log retention with minimum-period guardrail legal-exception override and auditable deletion
limitations: Not a litigation hold; data-protection and other Union/national law can alter retention; phased applicability preserved

trigger_scope: Automatically generated logs under deployer control after applicable high-risk date
requirement_candidate: Retain deployer-controlled logs for a period appropriate to intended purpose and at least six months unless other applicable law provides otherwise
evidence_required: Retention configuration; control/ownership record; deletion history; integrity evidence
technical_control_candidate: Deployer-side log custody and retention control with auditable policy enforcement
limitations: Not a universal retention duty for every AI deployer; data-protection and phased applicability preserved

trigger_scope: In-scope high-risk AI provider after applicable Article 6 pathway date
requirement_candidate: Establish document and maintain the legally required quality-management system and related provider compliance processes
evidence_required: QMS policy/process set; accountable owners; design/change/review records; compliance checks; version history
technical_control_candidate: AI lifecycle QMS with controlled procedures approvals change management evidence and compliance review
limitations: Provider/entity duty does not establish director/officer personal liability or mandate a specific board committee; phased applicability preserved
